config.inference: Exploratory observational associations. Primary18binary shape contrasts per coin use week-cluster bootstrap win-rate differences and wild-cluster score tests with side,calendar-half and log risk-bp controls. Holm across36primary tests. Fisher exact nominal p is descriptive only. All18cached exits and temporal/side cuts are stability diagnostics, not extra optimized filters or independent validation. No model training.
config.features: Touch candle OHLC and matched key; arrow candle OHLC; trailing5/8/20closed15m candles; ATR14 ending before touch; touch-to-entry movement observed by entry close. No post-entry candles used as predictors. Frozen files lack volume.

limitations: Small selected observational cohort; known history, not untouched validation. Multiple cuts overlap and are not additive. Conditional random references inherit signal-selected groups, not random shape matching. Week independence and linear nuisance adjustment are approximations. No volume data, no post-entry predictor, no new trade rule.
